skill.name: architect-review
skill.description: Reviews software architecture for scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, pattern compliance, and documented tradeoffs.
skill.summary: Assess system designs and produce prioritized architecture recommendations with validation steps.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both low-severity static findings are false positives. The cited lines provide architecture review guidance and list a multi-cloud topic without requesting reconnaissance or sensitive system access.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid approving high-risk changes without validation plans.
- Multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architecture strategies

finding_verdicts.reason: The line advises against approving high-risk changes without validation plans. It does not request system discovery, command execution, data access, or collection.
The line lists multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architecture strategies as a review topic. It contains no instruction to inspect hosts, enumerate resources, or collect system data.

content.value_statement: Complex system changes can hide scalability, resilience, security, and maintainability risks. This skill reviews architecture decisions and provides prioritized recommendations with tradeoffs and validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Reviews proposed system designs and major changes for architectural impact.
Evaluates scalability, resilience, security, performance, maintainability, testability, and cost concerns.
Checks designs against clean architecture, DDD, microservices, event-driven, API, and distributed-system patterns.
Identifies architectural violations, weak service boundaries, coupling, data consistency risks, and operational gaps.
Recommends improvements with tradeoffs, priorities, refactoring guidance, and concrete next steps.
Supports architecture documentation through C4 views, ADR guidance, and validation plans.
limitations: Requires system context, requirements, constraints, and expected workloads for a useful review.
Does not validate deployed infrastructure, benchmark performance, or execute security tests.
Recommendations require team review and environment-specific testing before implementation.
Broad architecture guidance may need specialist input for regulated, proprietary, or vendor-specific systems.

use_cases.title: Plan a service extraction
use_cases.description: Evaluate a proposed service split before committing teams to a migration.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering leads planning major system changes

use_cases.title: Review a cloud platform
use_cases.description: Assess resilience, observability, deployment, and cost tradeoffs across a cloud-native platform.

use_cases.title: Prepare a product for growth
use_cases.description: Identify near-term architecture risks and create a practical improvement sequence for a growing product.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic architecture review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this system design: [design]. The goals are [goals], and the constraints are [constraints]. Identify the three most important architecture risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a focused first review of a documented design.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two design options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [system]. Evaluate scalability, resilience, maintainability, security, cost, and delivery complexity. Recommend one option with tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a team must select between competing approaches.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a distributed system
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this distributed system design: [context]. Analyze service boundaries, data ownership, consistency, failure modes, observability, security, and deployment. Prioritize findings and propose validation steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for systems with multiple services, data stores, or asynchronous workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Design an evolutionary migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the proposed migration from [current architecture] to [target architecture]. Map dependencies and failure risks. Propose phased changes, rollback criteria, measurable checks, and an ADR outline.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a high-impact migration that requires governance and staged delivery.

output_examples.input: Review a proposal to split billing from a monolith before a traffic increase.
output: Impact: High. Billing boundaries and transaction ownership need explicit definitions before extraction.
Primary risks: dual writes, unclear retry behavior, and incomplete reconciliation.
Recommendation: use an outbox-based migration, define idempotency rules, and validate with failure-injection tests.

output_examples.input: Compare serverless functions with containers for a scheduled data-processing workload.
output: Recommendation: choose serverless for irregular workloads when execution limits and startup latency are acceptable.
Choose containers when processing is long-running, resource-heavy, or dependent on specialized runtime controls.
Validate both options with workload duration, concurrency, cost, recovery, and observability targets.

best_practices: Provide current architecture, proposed changes, traffic expectations, data sensitivity, and operational constraints.
Ask for prioritized findings and require each recommendation to include tradeoffs and validation criteria.
Confirm recommendations through prototypes, load tests, threat modeling, and stakeholder review before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request an architecture verdict without goals, constraints, or system context.
Do not adopt fashionable patterns when simpler designs meet the stated quality requirements.
Do not treat recommendations as proof of production readiness or regulatory compliance.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best review?
faq.answer: Provide system goals, current and proposed designs, dependencies, workloads, constraints, failure expectations, and relevant diagrams or ADRs.

faq.question: Can this skill create architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It can outline C4 views and diagram content, but rendered diagrams depend on the available host tools.

faq.question: Can it review implementation code?
faq.answer: It can inspect code to understand boundaries and dependencies, but its focus is architecture rather than line-level defects.

faq.question: Does it validate architecture security?
faq.answer: It reviews security boundaries and common architecture risks. It does not replace penetration testing, specialist threat modeling, or compliance assessment.

faq.question: Which architecture patterns can it assess?
faq.answer: It covers clean architecture, DDD, microservices, event-driven systems, serverless designs, API patterns, and common distributed data patterns.

faq.question: How should teams use the recommendations?
faq.answer: Treat findings as decision support. Validate assumptions with stakeholders, prototypes, tests, operational evidence, and documented acceptance criteria.
